instruction: Fix `to_bytes` in `codec/_bytes.py` so it encodes with UTF-8, not Latin-1. The Latin-1 codec cannot represent non-ASCII characters, so encoding or byte-counting any CJK text raises `UnicodeEncodeError` and breaks `base64_encode`, `hex_encode` and `byte_count`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec/_bytes.py b/codec/_bytes.py
--- a/codec/_bytes.py
+++ b/codec/_bytes.py
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
 
 def to_bytes(text: str) -> bytes:
     """Encode ``text`` to its UTF-8 bytes."""
-    return text.encode("latin-1")
+    return text.encode("utf-8")
 
 
 def from_bytes(data: bytes) -> str:
